_note: The reusable prompt system. The model generates the whole poster, lettering included, so the type sits IN the paper world with its texture rather than being pasted flat on top. The two-tone split is part of the brief: 'Kaffee' in near-black, 'listen' in amber. Add a theme here to get a seasonal set.
base: A flat graphic cut-paper collage, designed as a poster — not a photograph. Shapes are cut and torn from textured paper and laid flat: clean geometric planes, hard origami fold lines shown as straight edges between two slightly different tones, one or two deliberately torn edges with a soft deckled fibre lip, a small square note, and a coffee ring rendered as a simple flat printed ring, slightly off-register. Visible paper grain inside every shape. Screen-printed risograph feel with limited flat inks, crisp vector-like edges, even flat lighting.
palette_rule: Strictly three flat inks: warm off-white paper as the ground, deep warm near-black, and exactly one saturated warm amber as the single accent, used boldly on large shapes. No other hue anywhere. No blue, no green, no pink, no teal, no pastel yellow.
negative: NOT a photograph: no photographic realism, no depth of field, no studio lighting, no cast shadows, no 3D rendering, no origami cranes or animals, no desk scene, no props, no plants, no leaves, no flowers, no hands, no people. Apart from those two lines of type, add no other words, no numbers, no labels, no signature, no watermark, no logo. Do not misspell anything. No gradients, no vignette, no sepia.

banner.composition: Wide horizontal composition. Keep the LEFT HALF calm and largely empty for the lettering; put the paper planes, the cut-paper cup and the printed ring in the right half.

square.composition: Square composition. The lettering sits across the middle; the paper planes, the cut-paper cup and the printed ring fill the upper and lower thirds without crowding it.

portrait.composition: Tall composition. The lettering sits in the upper half with clear space above and below it; the paper planes, the cut-paper cup and the printed ring occupy the lower half. Keep the top and bottom edges calm, they get cropped.

wide.composition: Everything — the lettering and every paper element — must sit inside a NARROW HORIZONTAL BAND across the vertical centre, roughly the middle third of the frame. The lettering is on the left of that band, the paper planes and the cut-paper cup on the right of it. The top third and the bottom third are plain empty paper with nothing in them at all, because they will be cropped away.

ultrawide.composition: Everything - the lettering and every paper element - must sit inside a very SHALLOW HORIZONTAL STRIP across the exact vertical centre, occupying only the middle QUARTER of the frame height. The lettering is on the left of that strip and the paper planes, the cut-paper cup and the printed ring are on the right of it, all scaled to fit within that shallow strip. The entire top three eighths and the entire bottom three eighths of the frame are plain empty paper with absolutely nothing in them, because they are cropped away. Set the lettering smaller than usual so it fits the shallow strip.

themes.halloween: One cut-paper crescent and one angular bat silhouette sit among the planes; the accent deepens toward burnt orange. Still three flat inks.
themes.christmas: One folded paper star and one narrow cut snowflake sit among the planes; the accent warms toward gold. Still three flat inks.
themes.easter: One cut-paper egg shape and one torn arc sit among the planes. Still three flat inks.
themes.wald: A row of angular cut-paper pine silhouettes runs along the lower edge. Still three flat inks.

lettering: THIS IS A TYPOGRAPHIC POSTER. The single word "Kaffeelisten" is the main subject, large and clearly readable in the calm area. Spell it EXACTLY K-a-f-f-e-e-l-i-s-t-e-n as one unbroken word with no space and no hyphen. SET IT IN TWO COLOURS WITHIN THE ONE WORD: the first six letters "Kaffee" in the deep warm near-black ink, and the last six letters "listen" in the saturated warm amber. The colour change happens mid-word with no gap. A clean modern geometric sans-serif, heavy weight, tight letter-spacing, printed flat on the paper so it carries the paper's grain. Directly beneath it, much smaller and lighter in near-black, the line "Die Kaffeeliste - ohne Papier." Letterforms crisp, even and correctly formed.
